title: Halve head dim: 4 heads -> 8 heads (HEAD_DIM 128 -> 64)
description: HEAD_DIM 128 -> 64, so n_head/n_kv_head goes 4 -> 8 at unchanged model_dim 512; nothing else touched.
reflection: NEGATIVE, and cleanly so. val_bpb 1.000306 vs baseline 0.997358 (+0.0029). The FLOP-neutrality held exactly as predicted -- 414.3M tokens vs ~412M, steady-state MFU 33.26% vs ~33.1%, peak VRAM 22.7GB, num_params 50.3M unchanged -- so this is a pure quality readout with no throughput confound: at dim 512 with QK-norm and RoPE, 4 heads of width 128 beat 8 heads of width 64. Head width matters more than head count here; my expressivity argument was wrong. Two corollaries worth having: HEAD_DIM 32 is now clearly not worth a slot, and the direction that is left unexplored is *wider* heads (HEAD_DIM 256 -> 2 heads), though I would not bet much on it given how monotone this looks. Attention shape is a settled axis; the next money is in model shape (DEPTH/ASPECT_RATIO) or in the fp32 logits path.
